title: dedicated: tokenbucket smoothing + throughput guarantees + utilization reporting
description: This PR implements token-bucket smoothing in the Dedicated Fleet autoscaler, introduces per-fleet throughput guarantees, and extends utilization reporting to include token-bucket ingress/egress metrics. Motivation: recent production incidents showed oscillation in scale decisions under bursty traffic and gaps in visibility for committed throughput vs observed. Changes: 1) Add TokenBucketSmoother layer that applies exponential smoothing to token bucket refill/consume rates to avoid aggressive scaling on short spikes. 2) Add throughput_guarantee config on FleetSpec with enforcement hooks in the admission controller and autoscaler; includes quota calculation and fallback behavior when guarantees cannot be met. 3) Emit new metrics (dedicated.fleet.tokenbucket.queued, .refill_rate_smoothed, .guaranteed_throughput, .throttle_events) and extend existing fleet utilization reports to include guaranteed vs observed throughput and tokenbucket headroom. 4) Add integration tests and dashboard JSON for the Console. Backwards compatibility: defaults preserve current behavior unless throughput_guarantee is set; smoothing defaults to a conservative alpha (0.15). Includes migration for persisted FleetPolicy protobuf (adds optional fields). See commits for details.
